events.text: Rezidor Hotel Group was founded by SAS Group as a hotel.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Originally founded by Scandinavian conglomerate SAS Group as a hotel in 1960

events.subject: self
events.quote: it became a listed company in 2006

events.text: The global headquarters of Rezidor relocated to Brussels, Belgium.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The global headquarters of Rezidor relocated to Brussels , Belgium , circa 1989

events.text: The Radisson brand was franchised from Carlson Companies.
events.subject: self
events.quote: franchised from American hospitality and travel conglomerate Carlson Companies from 1994

events.text: The other brands were franchised from Carlson Companies.
events.subject: self

events.text: Carlson Companies acquired 25% of the shares of Rezidor Hotel Group from SAS Group.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2005 , Carlson Companies acquired 25% of the shares of Rezidor Hotel Group from SAS Group

events.text: Carlson Companies ceased to be a shareholder of the company.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2007 , Carlson Companies ceased to be a shareholder of the company

events.text: Carlson Companies acquired control of the listed company.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2010 , Carlson Companies acquired control ( more than 50.1% shares ) of the listed company

events.text: Rezidor Hotel Group started to integrate with Carlson Hotels, Inc.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2012 , Rezidor Hotel Group started to integrate with the direct parent company ( Carlson Hotels , Inc. )

events.text: Carlson Rezidor was one of the top hotel corporations.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Carlson Rezidor was one of the top hotel corporations in 2013

events.text: Carlson Hotels, Inc. and its subsidiaries, including Rezidor Hotel Group, were sold to HNA Group.
events.subject: self
events.quote: were sold to Chinese conglomerate HNA Group in 2016

events.text: Rezidor Hotel Group AB was renamed to Radisson Hospitality AB.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Rezidor Hotel Group AB was then renamed to Radisson Hospitality AB

events.text: Radisson Hotel Group was re-sold to a consortium led by Jin Jiang International of China.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2018 , Radisson Hotel Group was re-sold to a consortium led by Jin Jiang International of China
